name: edgedesk-sports
description: EdgeDesk Sports — a static research terminal, the deterministic football and UFC pipelines that feed it, the public article system that publishes what they find, and the editorial system that audits every published prediction against what actually happened. No dependencies: every script here runs on a bare Node install, and the browser reads committed artifacts rather than computing anything.
